title: NoiseHound edge-mapping entry
description: One BloodHound edge type mapped to its detection surface and static noise score. One file per edge type under edge_mappings/, named <edge_type>.json.

edge_type.description: The BloodHound edge/right name, e.g. GenericAll, DCSync, ADCSESC1. Must match the filename.

description.description: One-line explanation of the edge and how it is abused.

static_noise_score.description: Baseline expected detection cost, 0 (silent) to 100 (near-certain detection), assuming default auditing.

telemetry.description: Detection sources this edge's abuse touches.

event_id.description: Numeric event ID for windows_security/windows_system/sysmon; null for Azure/Entra (use activity name in detail) and other sources.

default_enabled.description: Whether the relevant auditing/logging is on by default in a stock domain.

product_class.description: For edr_heuristic: generic, EDR, MDI, etc.

mitre_technique.description: Primary MITRE ATT&CK technique id, e.g. T1003.006.

abuse_primitive.description: The tool/command an operator uses to traverse the edge. Doubles as the lab exercise step.
